title: Parchame Islam Hai
body:
parchame islam tujh par salaam
moula ghazi ka alam hi parchame islam hai
apni jad amjad se paaya virsa mein inaam hai
parchame islam hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
tu shabeehe murtaza aur waarise jaah o hashm
ud gaya haibat se teri kufr ka araam hai
parchame islam hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
jin ke nana ke liye aalam hua taqleeq hai
berida wo bibiyan hai aur balwa aam hai
parchame islam hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
jinhe bhi haq ne banaya tha karbala ke liye
wo sab ke sab hi namoona thay do sara ke liye
magar yaqeen ye kaamil ke hazrate abbas
bataur e khaas banaye gaye wafa ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
kis khadar teri wafa ke charche hai aqwaam mein
thi wafa benaam warna tu wafa ka naam hai
parchame islam hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
matam o majlis azadari shaah mazloom ki
saari dunya ke liye haq ka yehi paigham hai
parchame islam hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
jab lage pathar barasne to sakina ne kaha
ye sitamgaron ki nagri phuphi amma shaam hai
parchame islam hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
seh roz ke pyase bachon ki afsos ke pyaas bujhi na
aagaya beech bhawar ke logon hyder ka paak safina
chacha ko kabse dekhti hai par aaya nazr kahin na
asghar ke waaste dekhi hia lekar ke jaam sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
muntazir apne chacha ki hai sakina laadli
kab se asghar ke liye wo leke baithi jaam hai
parchame islam hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ameer apni ibadat tazkera shabbir ka
madhe aale rasool karna yehi apna kaam hai
parchame islam hai…
author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi
